conventions.bare_invocation: on a TTY opens the TUI; when stdout is not a TTY prints `triage --json`
conventions.json: pass --json (global flag) for a JSON object on stdout; errors become {ok:false,code,code_name,error,hint} on stdout with the same exit code
conventions.local_commands: native search, RSS except grab, and Shows except grab operate without opening the torrent engine
conventions.native_connect: torrent commands open the app when closed unless autostart=false; status and triage never launch it
conventions.selectors: torrents are selected by hash prefix (>= 4 hex chars) or a unique case-insensitive substring of the name; `all` selects every torrent
conventions.stdout: data only; diagnostics and progress go to stderr

defaults.save_path: the configured folder, or the desktop Downloads folder
defaults.upload: limited (native: 1 B/s; legacy: 32 KiB/s); stops when complete unless seed enabled

description: Torrent app for Omarchy with an embedded Rust engine, CLI, TUI, and bar widget. Downloads run while the app is open.

engines.native_lifetime: open app only; closing it stops downloads, peers, sockets and provider searches

env.NO_COLOR: accepted; the CLI never emits colour anyway

exit_codes.meaning: unexpected failure (bug or I/O); retrying rarely helps
exit_codes.name: failure

exit_codes.meaning: invalid arguments or input; the message names the exact fix
exit_codes.name: usage

exit_codes.meaning: refused for safety; re-run with the flag named in the hint
exit_codes.name: safety

exit_codes.meaning: torrent app unavailable; run `fbittorrent up` or `fbittorrent setup`
exit_codes.name: backend

exit_codes.meaning: torrent engine or a provider returned an error; inspect the message before retrying
exit_codes.name: upstream

exit_codes.meaning: no torrent, feed or plugin matched; `fbittorrent list --json` shows what exists
exit_codes.name: not_found

exit_codes.meaning: selector matched several items; use a longer hash prefix
exit_codes.name: ambiguous

exit_codes.meaning: `wait` timed out; the torrent is still there, poll `show <hash> --json`
exit_codes.name: timeout

native_features.interface_binding: required exact Linux interface; proton selects proton0
